query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration_environments (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  application_id INT NOT NULL,
  environment_type ENUM('sandbox', 'staging', 'production') NOT NULL,
  api_endpoint VARCHAR(512),
  status ENUM('provisioning', 'active', 'suspended', 'terminated') DEFAULT 'provisioning',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  expires_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  INDEX idx_application (application_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS api_credentials (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  application_id INT NOT NULL,
  environment_id INT NOT NULL,
  api_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  api_secret VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('active', 'revoked', 'expired') DEFAULT 'active',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  last_used_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  INDEX idx_application (application_id),
  INDEX idx_environment (environment_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sdk_downloads (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  application_id INT NOT NULL,
  sdk_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  downloaded_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_application (application_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration_tests (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  application_id INT NOT NULL,
  test_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  test_name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('pending', 'running', 'passed', 'failed') DEFAULT 'pending',
  result_data JSON,
  executed_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_application (application_id),
  INDEX idx_status (status)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
